description: This file implements HTML rendering functions for Markdown content, including functions for rendering block elements, inline elements, escaping URLs, and handling specific Markdown constructs like code blocks, images, links, and emojis.

methods.name: RenderHTML
methods.description: Main function to convert Markdown string to HTML.

methods.name: RenderBlockHTML
methods.description: Renders a block element of Markdown into HTML.

methods.name: renderBlockHTML
methods.description: Internal recursive function to render individual block elements.

methods.name: escapeURL
methods.description: Escapes special characters in URLs for safe HTML embedding.

methods.name: RenderInlineHTML
methods.description: Renders inline Markdown elements into HTML.

methods.name: renderImageAltText
methods.description: Generates alt text for images from inline elements.

methods.name: renderImageChildAltText
methods.description: Helper to generate alt text from inline elements within images.
